claim: The CloudFront FAQ names exceptions for Anycast Static IPs: they do not support legacy clients that cannot support SNI, and you are required to use Price Class All with them.

values.display: Anycast Static IPs will not support legacy clients
You are required to use Price Class All

note: mine-15-faq; register-15: the FAQ's third exception ('You must disable IPv6') is out of date: Anycast static IPs support dual-stack since 2025-11-05 (cloudfront-change-anycast-ipv6-2025-11); the claim leaves it out
